posts.title: Although or Despite?
posts.subtitle: Although · Despite · However

questions.q: ___ the heavy rain, the rescue team continued its search throughout the night.
questions.why: Despite + isim: the heavy rain bir isim öbeği.

questions.q: ___ the new drug proved effective in early trials, regulators refused to approve it without further evidence.
questions.why: Although + tam cümle; zıtlık da var.

questions.q: The company's profits rose sharply last year; ___, its employees received no pay rise.
questions.why: İki bağımsız cümle arasında zıtlık: ; however,

questions.q: ___ the fact that the bridge had been inspected recently, it collapsed during the storm.
questions.why: Despite the fact that + cümle kalıbı.

questions.q: ___ hard the researchers tried, they could not reproduce the original results.

posts.caption:
⚖️ YDT ve YDS'nin klasik tuzağı: Although, Despite, However!

Üçü de zıtlık anlatır ama aynı yapıyla kullanılmaz. Boşluktan sonra ne geldiğine bak: cümle mi, isim mi? 5 soruda kendini dene.

✍️ Cevaplarını yorumlara yaz (örnek: 1A 2C …), sonra son slayttan kontrol et.

posts.title: No Sooner, Hardly
posts.subtitle: -ir -mez yapısı

questions.q: No sooner had she arrived ___ it started to rain.
Hardly ___ the meeting begun when the power went off.
questions.why: Hardly had + özne + V3 ... when + V2.

questions.q: Scarcely had we left the house ___ we realized we had forgotten the keys.
No sooner ___ home than the phone rang.
questions.why: Olumsuz zarf başta: devrik had + özne + V3.

posts.caption:
⏱️ "-ir -mez" dedin mi akla bu yapılar gelsin: No sooner, Hardly, Scarcely.

YDT ve YDS'de zaman uyumu ve devrik yapıyla sınanır. 4 soruyu videoyu durdurarak çöz, cevaplar son slaytta.
